start.title: 위로부터 들려오는 음성
start.text:
하나님께서 너에게 말씀하십니다.
“너는 너를 위하여 방주를 만들라. 홍수가 올 것이다.”

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: 지켜보는 세상
mockery.text:
네 주변 세상은 타락하고 폭력적입니다.
그들은 네가 짓는 것을 지켜봅니다. 어떻게 반응하시겠습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: 잣나무와 역청
building.text:
너는 하나님께서 명령하신 재료들을 모읍니다.
방주를 어떻게 만드시겠습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: 완성된 모습
ark_done.text:
방주는 하나님께서 명령하신 대로 정확하게 완성되었습니다.
어떤 모습입니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: 문이 닫히다
boarding.text:
방주에 들어갈 시간입니다.
누가 들어가고, 누가 문을 닫습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

storm.title: 사십 일 밤낮 비
storm.text:
하늘의 창문이 열립니다.
무슨 일이 일어납니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: 물 위에서
inside.text:
방주가 깊은 물 위에 떠 있습니다.
물이 땅을 덮은 기간은 얼마나 됩니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: 비둘기가 돌아오다
dove.text:
물이 줄어들기 시작합니다.
마른 땅이 가까이 있음을 어떻게 아시겠습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: 네 발 아래 땅
dry_land.text:
주님께서 너에게 방주에서 나오라고 말씀하십니다.
마른 땅에서 가장 먼저 무엇을 하시겠습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: 무지개
covenant.text:
하늘에 무지개가 걸립니다.
“다시는 내가 땅을 홍수로 멸하지 아니하리라. 이것은 너와 맺은 나의 언약이니라.”
